comment: With !verbose, the Valkyrie takes off and wears her shield and un-readies her dagger from the inventory menu; the wielded spear's menu has no wield entry, so w does nothing and escape closes it. invent.c ddoinv() calls dispinv_with_action(), which hands the picked item to iactions.c itemactions(), whose itemactions_pushkeys() queues the command and the item letter, and invent.c getobj() takes the letter from cmdq_pop() without a prompt.
